column1: # Documented functions of gmodule/rel_gallery.prx (see re/documented.tsv for the columns; registry ids carry the module prefix, addresses here do not).

column3: summary

column2: void ui_gallery_vec_destruct(void *array, void *dtor, int stride, int count)
column3: Compiler array-destruction helper: for count elements of size stride starting at array, calls dtor(element, -1) from the last element back to the first. Returns nothing. Side effects: those of the destructor. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_grid_destroy, which passes ui_gallery_thumb_destroy, 0x24 and 0x82).

column2: void ui_gallery_vec_construct(void *array, void *ctor, void *dtor, int stride, uint count)
column3: Compiler array-construction helper: calls ctor(element, 1) on count elements of size stride; the unwinding branch (destroying already built elements with dtor(element, -1) when dtor is not ui_gallery_vec_destruct) is unreachable after a full loop. Returns nothing. Side effects: those of the constructor. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_grid_construct, which passes ui_gallery_thumb_construct, ui_gallery_thumb_destroy, 0x24, 0x82).

Allocates 0x20 bytes on the module heap (0x003099c0) and constructs a base task object (ui_gallery_task_construct) that serves as the head of the update list (+0x08) and draw list (+0x14); stores it (or 0) in the manager global 0x000099a0. Returns nothing. Side effects: heap allocation, writes 0x000099a0. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_app_init).

Walks the update list starting at manager+0x08 (links at +0x08) and calls the update method (vtable at +0x1c, slot +0x10) of every task whose update flag (+0x18) is 1. Returns nothing. Side effects: those of the task update methods (for the background task: ui_gallery_bg_task_update). Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_update).

Empty method of the gallery's base task class: returns without doing anything (jr ra; nop, v0 not set). It fills slot +0x10 (update) of the base vtable 0x0000990c {0, 0, ui_gallery_task_destroy, attach, update, draw, detach}, which the background task overrides (vtable 0x00009928). No side effects. No direct caller (reached through the vtable at 0x0000990c).

Walks the draw list starting at manager+0x14 (links at +0x14) and calls the draw method (vtable +0x14) of every task whose draw flag (+0x19) is 1. Returns nothing. Side effects: GE commands posted by the task draw methods. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_draw).

Empty method of the gallery's base task class: returns without doing anything (jr ra; nop, v0 not set). It fills slot +0x14 (draw) of the base vtable 0x0000990c {0, 0, ui_gallery_task_destroy, attach, update, draw, detach}, which the background task overrides (vtable 0x00009928). No side effects. No direct caller (reached through the vtable at 0x0000990c).

Repeatedly takes the first task of the update list (manager+0x08), detaches it with ui_gallery_detach_task(task, 1) and deletes it through its vtable slot +0x08 (flag 1), then deletes the manager itself the same way and clears the manager global 0x000099a0. Returns nothing. Side effects: frees all tasks and the manager. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_app_term).

column2: void ui_gallery_link_update_list(void *task, int priority, int before_equal)
column3: Inserts task into the update list headed at manager+0x08, kept sorted by ascending priority (node layout: +0x00 priority, +0x04 prev, +0x08 next); when before_equal is 0 the task goes after existing nodes of equal priority, otherwise before them. Stores priority at task+0x00. Returns nothing. Side effects: rewrites the list links. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_attach_task).

column2: void ui_gallery_link_draw_list(void *task, int priority, int before_equal)
column3: Same as ui_gallery_link_update_list for the draw list headed at manager+0x14 (node layout: +0x0c priority, +0x10 prev, +0x14 next). Returns nothing. Side effects: rewrites the list links. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_attach_task).

column2: void ui_gallery_attach_task(void *task, int update_priority, int draw_priority, int before_equal, char call_hook)
column3: When call_hook is 1 calls the task's attach method (vtable +0x0c), then links the task into the update list with update_priority and into the draw list with draw_priority (ui_gallery_link_update_list, ui_gallery_link_draw_list). Returns nothing. Side effects: list links, those of the attach method. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_create_bg_task, which passes priorities 0/0 or 3/3 and call_hook 1).

Empty method of the gallery's base task class: returns without doing anything (jr ra; nop, v0 not set). It fills slot +0xc (init/attach) of the base vtable 0x0000990c {0, 0, ui_gallery_task_destroy, attach, update, draw, detach}, which the background task overrides (vtable 0x00009928). No side effects. No direct caller (reached through the vtable at 0x0000990c).

If task is found in the update list (manager+0x08), unlinks it, zeroes its priority (+0x00) and its prev/next links (+0x04, +0x08). Returns nothing. Side effects: rewrites the list links. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_detach_task).
If task is found in the draw list (manager+0x14), unlinks it and zeroes +0x0c, +0x10 and +0x14. Returns nothing. Side effects: rewrites the list links. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_detach_task).

Removes task from both lists (ui_gallery_unlink_update_list, ui_gallery_unlink_draw_list) and, when call_hook is 1, calls its detach method (vtable +0x18). Returns nothing. Side effects: list links, those of the detach method. Callers: 2 (ui_gallery_destroy_tasks, ui_gallery_bg_task_update).

Empty method of the gallery's base task class: returns without doing anything (jr ra; nop, v0 not set). It fills slot +0x18 (term/detach) of the base vtable 0x0000990c {0, 0, ui_gallery_task_destroy, attach, update, draw, detach}, which the background task overrides (vtable 0x00009928). No side effects. No direct caller (reached through the vtable at 0x0000990c).

Base task constructor: sets the vtable pointer at +0x1c to 0x0000990c, clears the update node (+0x00..+0x08) and draw node (+0x0c..+0x14) and sets the update (+0x18) and draw (+0x19) enable flags to 1. Returns task. Side effects: writes the object. Callers: 2 (ui_gallery_bg_task_construct, ui_gallery_create_task_manager).
Zeroes the three words of a list node (priority, prev, next). Returns nothing. Side effects: writes node. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_task_construct).

Base task destructor: restores the base vtable 0x0000990c and frees the object with operator delete when flags > 0. Returns task. Side effects: may free the object. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_bg_task_destroy); also reached through the base vtable.

Allocates 0x90 bytes on the module heap, constructs a background-animation task (ui_gallery_bg_task_construct), attaches it with priorities 0/0 when kind is 0 or 3/3 otherwise (ui_gallery_attach_task with call_hook 1), then stores kind and auto_delete (ui_gallery_bg_task_set_kind). Returns the task (0 when allocation failed). Side effects: heap allocation, list links. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_update, kind 0 at state 1).
Runs the base task constructor and then sets the vtable at +0x1c to 0x00009928 (background-animation task). Returns task. Side effects: writes the object. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_create_bg_task).

Background task destructor: restores vtable 0x00009928, runs the base destructor without freeing, then frees the object when flags > 0. Returns task. Side effects: may free the object. No direct caller (vtable 0x00009928).

Background task method that resets its state: zeroes the 0x60-byte ehf draw parameter block at +0x20, the player pointer +0x80, the end frame +0x88 and the done/auto-delete bytes +0x8c/+0x8d, sets kind +0x84 to 1 and sets bit 0x10000 of the draw parameter word +0x2c. Probably the attach hook (vtable +0x0c) that ui_gallery_attach_task calls before the kind is set (hypothesis, confidence medium). Returns nothing. Side effects: writes the task. No direct caller (reached through vtable 0x00009928).

column2: void ui_gallery_bg_task_set_kind(void *task, int kind, char auto_delete)
column3: Stores kind at +0x84 and auto_delete at +0x8d; for kind 0 sets the end frame +0x88 to 399 (a looping background). Returns nothing. Side effects: writes the task. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_create_bg_task).

Background task update method. On first call (player +0x80 null) gets the app's resource slot 0 (basic.ehp, via ui_gallery_get_app, ui_gallery_get_app_resources, ui_gallery_get_slot), finds the ehf member named by the pointer table 0x00008db0[kind] (first entry gallerybg_ehf), allocates its work buffer and initialises an ehf player at frame 0. Then advances the frame counter +0x20: kind 0 wraps from the end frame +0x88 back to 0 and seeks the player; other kinds stop at the end frame, set done (+0x8c = 1) and, when auto_delete (+0x8d) is 1, detach and delete the task. Returns nothing. Side effects: heap allocation, player state, may free the task. No direct caller (vtable 0x00009928).
Returns the first word of the app object, the resource-set pointer. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_bg_task_update).
Returns the app object global 0x003099c8. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_bg_task_update).

Background task draw method: when an ehf player exists (+0x80), draws it on GE layer 4 with ui_ehf_begin_draw / ui_ehf_draw(list, player, task+0x20) / ui_ehf_end_draw and commits the layer pointer. Returns nothing. Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (vtable 0x00009928).

Frees the ehf player work buffer at +0x80 (operator delete[]) and clears the pointer. Probably the detach hook (vtable +0x18) (hypothesis, confidence medium). Returns nothing. Side effects: frees memory. No direct caller (vtable 0x00009928).

Module entry point of rel_gallery: when arg is 0 registers the scene with system_scene_register(ui_gallery_scene_main, ui_gallery_scene_end, 0x000099a4). Same machine code as shop_module_start of rel_shop. Returns 0. Side effects: the scene registration. No direct caller (module entry point).

Scene start callback (scene 0x1e): clears the loading overlay, runs ui_gallery_scene_init, installs the frame callbacks with system_scene_set_frame_callback(2, ui_gallery_frame_callback, ui_gallery_leave_callback), loops ui_gallery_scene_update plus system_wait_frame until it reports completion, then restores the no-op callbacks, shows the loading overlay, waits one frame and calls system_scene_return(0x1e, 0). Returns nothing. Side effects: the whole gallery session and the scene return. Registered as the scene start callback by ui_gallery_module_start.
Empty function. Returns nothing. No side effects. Registered as the scene end callback by ui_gallery_module_start.

Sets the current thread attribute 0x4000 (sceKernelChangeCurrentThreadAttr(0, 0x4000)), creates a 0x300000-byte heap over the module buffer at 0x000099c0 (system_heap_create, stored in 0x003099c0) and registers it for delete, allocates the 0x110-byte app object (ui_gallery_app_construct, stored in 0x003099c4), runs ui_gallery_app_init on it and sets the active flag 0x000099b0 to 1. Returns nothing (the caller tests a return value, which the decompilation does not show). Side effects: heap creation, app globals. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_scene_main).
Sets the app vtable pointer at +0x10c to 0x00009974 and stores app in the global 0x003099c8. Returns app. Side effects: writes 0x003099c8. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_scene_init).

Runs one step of the app state machine (ui_gallery_update on 0x003099c4); when it reports completion clears the active flag 0x000099b0. Returns true when the gallery has finished. Side effects: those of ui_gallery_update. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_scene_main).

Frame callback: when the active flag 0x000099b0 is set, draws the gallery (ui_gallery_draw on 0x003099c4). Returns nothing. Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (installed by ui_gallery_scene_main with system_scene_set_frame_callback).

Leave callback: tears the app down (ui_gallery_app_term), deletes the app object through its vtable (+0x10c, slot +0x08), clears 0x003099c4, queries the heap usage (result unused), unregisters and frees the module heap 0x003099c0. Returns nothing. Side effects: frees all gallery memory. No direct caller (installed by ui_gallery_scene_main).

App destructor: restores vtable 0x00009974, clears the app global 0x003099c8 and frees the object when flags > 0. Returns app. Side effects: writes 0x003099c8, may free memory. No direct caller (vtable 0x00009974).

Thumbnail update method (36-byte thumbnail: +0x04/+0x08 position, +0x0c/+0x10 target, +0x18 moving flag, +0x1e delay). While the delay byte +0x1e is non-zero it only decrements it; otherwise, when moving (+0x18 == 1), moves the position a quarter of the way to the target and snaps and clears the flag when the squared distance is below 1.0. Returns 0. Side effects: writes the thumbnail. No direct caller (thumbnail vtable 0x0000995c, called by ui_gallery_grid_update).

Thumbnail draw method: posts one sprite at the integer position (+0x04, +0x08) with texture coordinates (+0x14, +0x16) using the sprite extent set by the caller (52 x 28). Returns nothing. Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (thumbnail vtable, called by ui_gallery_grid_draw).

Thumbnail frame method: posts one sprite at position - 3 pixels with texture coordinates (0x3d, 0x15) of the bg_tf1 GIM, using the 58 x 34 extent set by the caller. Returns nothing. Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (thumbnail vtable, called by ui_gallery_grid_draw).

Thumbnail-grid constructor (0x128c bytes): sets the vtable at +0x1288 to 0x00009944, constructs 0x82 thumbnails of 0x24 bytes (ui_gallery_vec_construct), clears their first words and clears the GIM pointers +0x1278..+0x1280. Returns grid. Side effects: writes the object. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_app_init).
Thumbnail destructor: restores vtable 0x0000995c at +0x20 and frees when flags > 0. Returns thumb. Side effects: may free memory. No direct caller (passed to the array helpers).
Thumbnail constructor: vtable 0x0000995c at +0x20, delay byte +0x1e = 0. Returns thumb. Side effects: writes the object. No direct caller (passed to ui_gallery_vec_construct).

Grid method (vtable +0x0c): finds thumbnail1e_gim, thumbnail2e_gim and bg_tf1_gim in resource slot 0 (basic.ehp) and stores them at +0x127c/+0x1280/+0x1284. Then, for each of 6 pages, records the page's first thumbnail at +0x1248 + page * 8 and its count at +0x124c + page * 8 from the byte table 0x00008a20, and initialises each thumbnail: active, page number, position and target (800, 800), sheet flag +0x1f (second sheet when the item index is above 0x47) and texture coordinates: unlocked items (unlocked[item] non-zero) use cell (n & 3) * 0x34, (n >> 2) * 0x1c with n = (index in page + start table 0x00008a28[page]) % 0x48; locked items use the placeholder (0x68, 0x188) on the second sheet. Returns nothing. Side effects: writes the grid. No direct caller (grid vtable 0x00009944, called by ui_gallery_update in state 1).

Grid method (vtable +0x10): calls the update method (ui_gallery_thumb_update) of each of the 0x82 thumbnails whose active halfword is 1. Returns nothing. Side effects: thumbnail positions. No direct caller (grid vtable, called by ui_gallery_update every frame).

Grid method (vtable +0x14): when both thumbnail sheets are loaded, on GE layer 4 sets nearest filtering, alpha blend and white ambient, draws all active thumbnails' frames with the bg_tf1 texture (extent 58 x 34), then each thumbnail (extent 52 x 28) with thumbnail1e or thumbnail2e according to its sheet flag. Returns nothing. Side effects: GE commands. No direct caller (grid vtable, called by ui_gallery_draw).

Starts the fly-in of a page's thumbnails to their grid cells (target x = column * 60 + 64, y = row * 32 + 40, 6 columns), picking one of four patterns with (system_rand_shifted() % 400) / 100: 3 = from random x at y 320; 2 = from (224, 320) with a serpentine delay; 1 = alternately from x 480 and x 0 at y 320; 0 = first 16 from x 0, the rest from x 480. Sets each thumbnail active and moving with a delay byte. Returns nothing. Side effects: writes thumbnails. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_grid_animate_page).
Sends every thumbnail of the page to (224, 280) with serpentine delays (moving flag set). Returns nothing. Side effects: writes thumbnails. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_grid_animate_page).

column2: void ui_gallery_grid_animate_page(void *grid, int page, int direction)
column3: Page animation dispatcher: direction 0 runs ui_gallery_grid_start_enter, 0xffff runs ui_gallery_grid_start_exit; otherwise the current page's thumbnails fly off horizontally (targets x = -direction * 540 + random, y 32..223) and the page (page + 6 + direction) % 6 flies in from x = direction * 540 + random, y 128..255 to its grid cells. Returns nothing. Side effects: writes thumbnails, consumes random numbers. Callers: 2 (ui_gallery_update, ui_gallery_change_page).

Grid destructor (vtable +0x08): restores vtable 0x00009944, destroys the 0x82 thumbnails (ui_gallery_vec_destruct) and frees the grid when flags > 0. Returns grid. Side effects: may free memory. No direct caller (grid vtable, called by ui_gallery_app_term).

Initialises the 0x110-byte app object: loads audio track 0x2c8, clears the state fields (state +0x10 = 0, page +0x18 = 2, cursor and text fields, rectangle 224/320/58/34, lerp 0.25), computes the 0x82 unlock bytes at +0x88 (ui_gallery_compute_unlocks), creates the task manager, allocates and clears the 0xfc-byte resource set (+0x00) and the thumbnail grid (+0x0c), sets +0x16 to 1 when save_get_language() is 0, initialises the 3D render state on layer 0, queues the loads of resource slots 0x3a (language ehp) and 0 (basic.ehp) (ui_gallery_load_slot), plays BGM track 0x1e with fade and starts a fade-out (1, 0, 1). Returns nothing. Side effects: heap allocations, file loads, audio. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_scene_init).
Resource-set constructor: vtable 0x00009980 at +0xf4, last file size +0xf0 = 0. Returns resources. Side effects: writes the object. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_app_init).

Fills the 0x82 unlock bytes at app+0x88: items 0-14 when save_test_progress_flag_e9_bit7, items 15-23 when save_test_progress_flag_ea_bit0, items 24-56 from save_test_picture_seen(bit) with the 33 bit numbers copied from 0x0000953c, item 57 always, item 58 when any character 2..0x8e has an existing variant with save_test_character_flag_bit2, item 59 when character 2 variants 0 and 1 both have that flag, and items 60-129 copied from the save state bytes at +0x153e4 + the index table 0x00008a37.. (one byte per item). Returns nothing. Side effects: writes app+0x88..+0x109. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_app_init).

Tears down the app: destroys all tasks (ui_gallery_destroy_tasks), terminates the 3D render state, frees all resource buffers (ui_gallery_free_slots), deletes the resource set and the grid through their vtables and releases audio track 0x2c8. Returns nothing. Side effects: frees memory, audio. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_leave_callback).
Resource-set destructor: restores vtable 0x00009980 and frees when flags > 0. Returns resources. Side effects: may free memory. No direct caller (vtable 0x00009980).

Empty function: returns without doing anything (jr ra; nop). ui_gallery_update calls it once in state 1 with the app record when the load check (0x000029b4) reports completion, just before the thumbnail GIMs are requested. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_update).

Copies the loaded picture file (size from ui_gallery_get_loaded_size) to the fixed buffer 0x00709a00, patches header bytes at +0x14 (8), +0x16, +0x26, +0x486, +0x48a, +0x4b2 (4) and +0x49b (2), then rebuilds part of the pixel data with ui_gallery_copy_transposed_tile (2 x (32 + 28) tile copies). The header offsets look like a GIM block header with a 0x400-byte palette (hypothesis, confidence low); the purpose of the tile copies (rotating or reflowing the image) is not established. Returns 0x00709a00. Side effects: writes the picture buffer. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_zoom_in_picture).
Returns resources+0xf0, the size of the last picture file loaded into slots 1..0x39. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_prepare_picture).

Browse-state input: updates the cursor (ui_gallery_update_cursor) and the arrow pulse (+0x74/+0x76, 0x60..0xff), then reads the pad edge word (+0x0c): the button of system_get_confirm_button(1) plays sound 0x7a06 and returns 3 (leave); the confirm button (system_get_confirm_button(0)) plays the buzzer 0x7a07 and returns 0 while the cursor is moving or the item is locked, otherwise stores the item (+0x7a), requests picture slot item + 1 (ui_gallery_load_picture) when item < 0x39 or stores movie index item - 0x39 at +0x78, plays 0x7a05 and returns 1; R (0x200) or square (0x8000) sets direction +0x58 = 1, L (0x100) sets -1, both reset the cursor, play 0x7a0d and return 2; else 0. Side effects: app fields, sound, resource load. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_update).

Picture open animation, once the current picture slot is loaded: on the first step (+0x38 == 0) prepares the texture (ui_gallery_prepare_picture, pointer at +0x5c), starts the rectangle +0x3c..+0x48 at the selected cell (52 x 28) with linear filtering (+0x4c = 1). Each step raises alpha +0x54 by 16 (max 0xff), sets +0x50 = alpha / 2 + 0x80 and moves the rectangle a quarter of the way to (0, 0, 480, 272); when close it snaps, sets nearest filtering and returns 1. Returns 0 while loading or animating. Side effects: writes app fields and the picture buffer. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_update, state 0x0b).
Returns the slot buffer resources[resources+0xf8], the currently requested picture (0 while loading). No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_zoom_in_picture).

Lowers the picture alpha (+0x54, +0x50) by 16; when it reaches 0 frees the picture slot (ui_gallery_free_picture) and clears the texture pointer +0x5c. Returns true when finished. Side effects: app fields, frees memory. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_update, state 0x0d).

Movie open animation: on the first step clears the texture pointer and starts the rectangle at the selected cell; each step raises the dim alpha +0x54 by 16 and grows the rectangle toward full screen; when done plays movie +0x78 with ui_gallery_play_movie (blocking) and returns 1. Returns 0 while animating. Side effects: app fields, movie playback. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_update, state 0x0e).
Lowers the dim alpha +0x54 by 10; at 0 clears it and the texture pointer +0x5c. Returns true when finished. Side effects: app fields. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_update, state 0x0f).
Returns true when circle or cross (pad edge bits 0x6000) is pressed, playing sound 0x7a05. Side effects: sound. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_update, state 0x0c).

Starts the page slide (ui_gallery_grid_animate_page with direction +0x58), sets page +0x18 to (page + 6 + direction) % 6 and refreshes the page title and item caption (ui_gallery_refresh_text 0 and 1). Returns 1. Side effects: app and grid fields. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_update, state 0x10).

column2: void ui_gallery_copy_transposed_tile(void *app, uint dst_column, int dst_row, uint src_column, int src_row)
column3: Copies an 8 x 8-byte tile inside the picture buffer: tile addresses are 0x00709ed0 + row * 0x1000 + column * 0x40 - (column & 1) * 0x38 with a 16-byte line stride; destination byte [i][k] takes source byte [i + (7 - k) * 0x10], i.e. the tile is transposed (rotated). app is unused. Returns nothing. Side effects: writes the picture buffer. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_prepare_picture).

Gallery state machine (state word +0x10), run every frame after updating tasks and the grid: 0 shows the black screen and goes to 1; 1 waits until no load is pending, sets up the grid, finds the GIMs thumbnail1e/thumbnail2e/side/hilight/bg_tf1 in basic.ehp (+0x60..+0x70), creates the looping background task, starts a 16-frame fade-in and goes to 3; 3 after the fade sets the texts, starts the page fly-in, goes to 10; 10 browse (ui_gallery_handle_input: 1 to 0x0b for pictures or 0x0e for movies with audio_stop_sound(0x1e, 500), 2 to 0x10, 3 to 0x11); 0x0b zoom in picture then 0x0c; 0x0c waits for circle/cross then 0x0d; 0x0d fades the picture back to 10; 0x0e plays the movie then 0x0f (restarts BGM 0x1e); 0x0f to 10; 0x10 page change to 10; 0x11 starts a 30-frame black fade-out, stops BGM, flies the grid out and centres the cursor, goes to 0x12; 0x12 returns 1 when the fade is done. Returns 1 when the gallery ends, else 0. Side effects: the whole screen state, audio, loads. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_scene_update).
Writes the task draw-enable byte +0x19. Returns nothing. Side effects: writes the task. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_update).
Returns resources+0xec, the number of file loads still pending. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_update).
Writes app+0x14; when 1 the draw function covers the screen with black (ui_gallery_draw_black_screen). Returns nothing. Side effects: writes the app. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_update).

Loads the movie modules (system_load_movie_modules(0, 1)) and waits for them, picks the movie name from the pair table at 0x000092f4 (entry movie * 2; when app+0x16 is 0, i.e. language not Japanese, the second pointer at 0x000092f8 is used if non-null), formats movie/%s.pmf, resolves it with container_resolve_path_lbn(root 3), sets the movie work memory to 0x00309a00 (0x400000 bytes) and plays it with system_movie_play_with_volume(path, 2, 0x40), then unloads the movie modules. Returns nothing. Side effects: blocking movie playback, module loads. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_zoom_in_movie).
Resets the cursor pulse: alpha +0x1e = 0xff, step +0x20 = -10. Returns nothing. Side effects: writes the app. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_update_cursor).

Moves the cursor to cell (0, 0): mode +0x1c = 2 (moving), column +0x21 and row +0x22 = 0, target (58, 34), lerp factor 0.25. Returns nothing. Side effects: writes the app. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_handle_input).
Sets the cursor target to (224, 280), moving mode, lerp factor from 0x00008bc4 (exit animation). Returns nothing. Side effects: writes the app. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_update).

Cursor update. In mode 2 moves the cursor (+0x24/+0x28) toward its target (+0x2c/+0x30) by factor +0x34 and switches to mode 1 (setting the arrows flag +0x15) when the squared distance is below 0x00008bbc. In mode 1 pulses the alpha +0x1e between 0x60 and 0xff and handles left/right/up/down with wrap on a 6-column grid limited to the item count of the page (byte table 0x00008a80); on a move plays sound 0x7a04, sets the target to (column * 60 + 58, row * 32 + 34) with factor 0x00008bc0 and refreshes the item caption. Returns nothing. Side effects: app fields, sound. Callers: 2 (ui_gallery_update, ui_gallery_handle_input).
Draws an opaque black 480 x 272 untextured sprite on GE layer 5. Returns nothing. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_draw).
When the dim alpha app+0x54 is non-zero, draws a black 480 x 272 sprite with that alpha on GE layer 4. Returns nothing. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_gallery_draw).
